title: Deep learning of contagion dynamics on complex networks
summary: GNN learned contagion dynamics and was evaluated on synthetic systems and Spain COVID outbreak data, yielding computational dynamics/source-inference results; no intervention or causal public-health claim. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
